name: assessing Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) demand
from: Demand Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube) took up from the work board (a request it promised or a report it adopted), held unassessed in its own root.
to: The demand is either Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s own work, admitted under the taken subject as items its own offices bear duties for, with any part it does not do posted back on the board; or it is given back (released or declined) with the reason it is not Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s work.
cost: Bounded assessment attention of Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s lead on the host's execution capacity; no financial, credential or external commitment.
otherwise: Demand about the Climate, Place-by-Place YouTube channel's videos, schedule and curriculum stays open on the board, at home with the micro-enterprise seated over the enclosing section or, where none is, owed to the market; nobody else holds Climate, Place-by-Place (YouTube)'s work.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the assessment's evidence and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own assessment.
